result.summary: The page is largely well-rendered, but one clear data/rendering defect is visible: the Smash Bros Burgers card displays '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid delivery fee. No other visual breakage was found outside the excluded carousel/viewport clipping behaviors.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel shows '€NaN delivery', indicating a failed numeric formatting/parsing of the delivery fee value.
issues.suggestion: Guard the delivery fee formatter against undefined/null/non-numeric values; fall back to a sensible label (e.g., 'Free delivery' or hide the fee line) and fix the upstream data source returning an invalid fee.
